Data:Recruit.mr.k.friend.json.label: Assistance from Mr Kille
Data:Recruit.mr.k.friend.json.startdescription: Mr Kille can always spare a few hours to help a friend.

Data:Recruit.mrs.k.friend.json.label: Assistance from Mrs Kille
Data:Recruit.mrs.k.friend.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille stands ready to help. 'You always cheer me up,' she says morosely.

Data:Recruit.mrs.k.json.label: Assistance from Mrs Kille
Data:Recruit.mrs.k.json.startdescription: 'A day's work is a night's dreaming.'

Data:Recruit.rectory.friend.json.label: Assistance from Reverend Timothy
Data:Recruit.rectory.friend.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy always jumps at the offer of my company.

Data:Recruit.smithy.friend.json.label: Assistance from Denzil the Blacksmith
Data:Recruit.smithy.friend.json.startdescription: Denzil rarely works for free. But he won't take payment for helping a friend. [But if you find occult coinage, you can give it to him for the Service of Division.]

Data:Recruit.sweetbones.barber.json.label: Assistance from a Travelling Barber
Data:Recruit.sweetbones.barber.json.startdescription: In summer, the barber comes by to keep the villagers kempt. A shilling will buy his services. [Barbers offer <sprite name=moth> and a little <sprite name=rose>. Alternatively, add a Soul card to find any rarer guests who might be seeking employment...]

Data:Recruit.sweetbones.exotic.json.label: Seek Unusual Help
Data:Recruit.sweetbones.exotic.json.startdescription: What visitors might be passing through? [Find out what unusual passersby might be looking for employment.]

Data:Recruit.sweetbones.fisherman.json.label: Assistance from a Fisherman
Data:Recruit.sweetbones.fisherman.json.startdescription: In winter when the storms close the seas, the fishermen will offer their services for a shilling a day. [Fishermen will offer <sprite name=moon> and a little <sprite name=sky>. Alternatively, add a Soul card to find any rarer guests who might be seeking employment...]

Data:Recruit.sweetbones.miner.json.label: Assistance from a Miner
Data:Recruit.sweetbones.miner.json.startdescription: In spring, the local miners often travel to the Feast of Lights Below. If one breaks his journey at the Sweet Bones, a shilling will buy his labour for a day. [Miners offer <sprite name=scale>, <sprite name=forge>, and a little <sprite name=moon>. Alternatively, add a Soul card to find any rarer guests who might be seeking employment...]

Data:Recruit.sweetbones.orchardkeeper.js.label: Assistance from an Orchard-Keeper
Data:Recruit.sweetbones.orchardkeeper.js.startdescription: In autumn, the orchard-keepers come to sell their wares at Brancrug. A shilling will buy one's help. [Orchard-keepers offer <sprite name=nectar> and a little <sprite name=heart>. Alternatively, add a Soul card to find any rarer guests who might be seeking employment...]
